integrity: Proof gives an all-length induction from a fully enumerated twelve-case bounded local lemma; exact checker included. No claim of independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact statements require a fixed 16-letter skeleton with free positions 8 and 16, terminal bit 1, and alphabet {0,1}; arbitrary paperfolding prefixes and independent mathematical priority checking are outside the scope.
title: Scattered-subsequence universality of paperfolding sixteen-block skeletons
